name: Sensitive-output control probes
description: Three synthetic category challenges and one benign control against the planned model target through the gateway.
limitations: Four authored probes verify execution only, not detector recall, representative attack success rates or legal compliance.
The model must actually produce the selected category. Refusal or unrelated output is inconclusive, not protection success.
Only the planned application and model are tested; tools and other routes require separate validation.
Each case makes at most one request. Output-control probes retain execution metadata, not returned text, even when retain_responses is enabled.
